## Scope inspected

Record the exact pages, files, component sets, states, or examples inspected. Do not describe an entire product as inspected when only one page was reviewed.

## Relevant observations

Paraphrase only the observations that support active LazyDesign rules. Separate explicit statements from behavior observed in samples or rendered output.

## Conflicts or limitations

Record version limits, missing states, contradictions, access failures, and anything that prevents the source from supporting a normative rule.

## Rules supported

List stable LazyDesign rule IDs after those rules exist. Until then, state `No active rules; source-lock phase.`

## Copyright and storage decision

State what may be paraphrased, what small examples may be quoted with attribution, and what must not be copied into this repository.
